highlights: Stencil: place a reference image over the model, then sculpt or paint through it, and move it and repeat (thanks @kenttumanda123-netizen, #155)

Maya Live: each stroke goes to Maya on its own, and Maya's edits come back the same way. An optional Live link makes it near-instant; it's off by default and warns when you turn it on (thanks @tristratos, #42)
Creature bones: 13 original starting pieces for building creatures, in Insert sets (thanks @kenttumanda123-netizen, #154)
Brush sets: swap the whole bottom shelf and its keys in one step (thanks @NicTanghe, #143)
Floor grid: View > Floor grid draws a faint grid on the floor the model stands on (thanks @fenixpoints, #115)
